datum: The Lord, He is King of the Apostles. * O come, let us worship Him, Alleluia.

incipit: With great power gave the Apostles:
responsum: Witness of the Resurrection of our Lord Jesus Christ, Alleluia.
versus: They were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they spake the word of God with boldness.

incipit: These are the new lambs, who have proclaimed, Alleluia: they came but just now to the well:
responsum: They are all filled with light, Alleluia, alleluia.
versus: They stand before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, and palms in their hands.
